shapeSummary: Black rectangular IR distance sensor housing: a 34 x 18.9 mm base block with two square lens towers extending along +Z to the 21.6 mm total depth. Round-ended mounting tabs sit at each end of the 44.5 mm length, each with a 3 mm through hole along Z. One tower has a shallow rectangular pocket for the visible open aperture.
warnings: Dimensions come from the unverified listed size (44.5 x 18.9 x 21.6 mm).
Axis assignment is assumed: X is the long axis, Y is the 18.9 mm height from the bottom at Y=0, and Z is the lens axis.
Tab thickness, hole spacing (38 mm), hole diameter (3 mm), tower size and base block depth are estimated from image proportions.
The pocket depth is also an estimate.
The lens dome in the right tower is omitted, so only the left tower aperture is cut.
The connector and PCB are not modeled.
cadquery:
base = cq.Workplane('XY').box(34, 18.9, 8, centered=(True, False, False)).translate((0, 0, -10.8))
towers = (cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(-8.5, 1.95), (8.5, 1.95)])
          .rect(11, 15, centered=(True, False)).extrude(13.8).translate((0, 0, -3)))
tabs = (cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(-19, 9.45), (19, 9.45)]).circle(3.25).extrude(3)
        .translate((0, 0, -10.8)))
bridges = (cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(-17.5, 6.2), (17.5, 6.2)])
           .rect(5, 6.5, centered=(True, False)).extrude(3).translate((0, 0, -10.8)))
holes = (cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(-19, 9.45), (19, 9.45)]).circle(1.5).extrude(30)
         .translate((0, 0, -15)))
pocket = cq.Workplane('XY').box(8, 11.5, 8, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((-8.5, 9.45, 2.8))
part = base.union(towers).union(tabs).union(bridges).cut(holes).cut(pocket)
